page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a woodcut ornamental border at the top and a large decorated initial at the start; a signature line in italic below the text; a catchword "Analy-" at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: EPistolarum omnium Apostolicarum Expositioni huicce a Clarissimo viro, Domino Davide Dicsono conscriptæ, studiosis Theologiæ utilissimæ, Authore simul ac lectore digniffimæ: utpote quæ spiritus scopum, verborum sensum, doctrinarum medullam, argumentorum aciem, optimè attingit, eruit, extrahit, extruit: in officium, potiùs quàm suffragium, hoc quantulumcunq; sit calculi, adijcere gestit

page.notes: The initial "E" is a decorated woodcut letter and is transcribed as "E" joined to "Pistolarum" as "EPistolarum". The word "calculi" is printed "calculj" with a long-tailed j; read as "calculi" and marked as doubtful. The word "Dicsono" appears as printed. A faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
